summary.en:
Haibara, Ayumi, Ran, Sonoko, and Sato go to an all-you-can-eat sweet shop in Haido Town Royal Hotel, celebrating the good health and future achievements of the girls. However...

Murder/Attempted murder

locations: An all-you-can-eat sweet shop in Haido Town Royal Hotel
suspects: Kyoka Kasai, Ryuichiro Mita and Shunsuke Yoshimura
locationsZh: 杯户町皇家酒店内的甜点自助店
suspectsZh: 葛西京香、三田龙一郎与吉村俊介
